sections: direct inbound units and actual logistics
spare_request_workbench.actions: derived from current projection and dependencies; draft/edit, Generate MSG, accept submission, enter/correct SR7, authorize RMA, reassign, receipt and correction remain distinct
spare_request_workbench.warning: 24-hour awaiting-response warning starts only after accepted submission

stock_view.rule: unavailable units remain discoverable through history/detail but are not selectable as eligible Stock

rules: receipt and final decision are visibly separate
rejected membership remains action-required even when predecessor attempt is terminal
pickup origin is explicitly labelled From/Pickup origin, not destination

bulk.rule: every selected target appears in exactly one partition; acceptance never silently skips/coerces

evidence.indexed_communication_reference: shown when present but optional for manual transition
evidence.rule: no paperclip/upload/dropzone anywhere in Beta 1.0 Inventory

accessibility: Every lifecycle/attention state uses text and/or icon in addition to color; unavailable predictable actions expose blocker/remediation rather than disappearing where discoverability is useful.
draft_rule: LLD-10 owns generic UI working-copy/undo implementation. This file defines only Inventory semantic availability/locking; client draft state is never domain authority.
